problem: CDC 2.11.2 adoption in g-spiral initially stalled because direct high-level writes of the canonical SKILL.md were rejected by the available write channel. The source was restored to exact 2.11.1, but the rollout was incorrectly classified transport_unavailable before probing an authorized low-level Git object transport.

hypotheses.statement: The released CDC 2.11.2 package could not be adopted because its bytes/tree were invalid or incomplete.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Assemble the canonical delta as Git blobs/tree and validate the resulting package plus full test suite.
hypotheses.observed_result: The target package tree assembled exactly to 7a7a7faa75b7fc9160d912d8fb507c6b9573d17f; package validator passed 316 files/templates and the full vendored suite passed 866/866.

hypotheses.statement: The target repository rejected all Git object writes, so no repository-side transport was possible.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Create the canonical SKILL.md as an opaque base64 Git blob without moving a ref.
hypotheses.observed_result: The low-level create_blob path succeeded and returned the exact canonical blob SHA 6379e80f7e1819550e58b4763113b7b4d12620ed.

hypotheses.statement: The execution channel classified transport unavailable after the high-level file-write path failed, without probing the lower-level carrier-neutral Git blob/tree transport that remained authorized and functional.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Retry the same exact package using base64 Git blob creation, exact tree assembly and one non-force ref update.
hypotheses.observed_result: All canonical blobs transferred with identical SHA, the exact package tree was reproduced before ref movement, the source advanced in one fast-forward commit, and validation run 36774463901 completed GREEN.

correction: Reinforce carrier-neutral package transport recovery: when a high-level contents/file write fails, classify the channel failure precisely and probe other authorized package carriers—especially low-level Git blob/tree assembly—before declaring transport unavailable. Build and verify the exact package tree before shared-ref movement; publish package+lock+policy atomically or restore the prior exact tree.
defense_in_depth: Retain the canonical per-path blob/mode manifest, verify every transported blob SHA, require exact final package-tree equality, use non-force ref movement, preserve an exact rollback tree, and keep transport failures separate from package-validation failures.
invariant: A consumer adoption may report transport unavailable only after all authorized carrier-neutral transports available to that invocation are reconciled. No transport strategy may publish a mixed vendored package or grant adoption authority without exact canonical package-tree identity.
